input_recovery.rule: An input is listed when it has no source-backed owner: an engine asset; a texture whose owner is an editor-owned (adopted) record; or helper code whose bytes are pinned in V2 but are not yet a dependency of the master. Parameter constants written in a pinned generator are not listed; the generator carries them. Status: engine-default (no donor file; needs reads allowlist); recoverable-now (pinned donor original and an existing importer); recoverable-by-port (generator pinned, pure code to port, output bytes reproduced); wire-dependency (bytes pinned in V2, the master must name them); not-recoverable (none in this pass).
